label: Retained readings from Thomas Aquinas, Summa contra gentiles
summary: I.12 [6]–[9]: SCG I.12 is used in docs/kant-cosmological-inference.md for the different epistemic roles of effects and prior knowledge of quiddity. Application to an existing causal route requires identifying a supplied effect and validating the demonstration from that effect to the same witness. I.16 [7]: some being that is only in act and in no wise in potency: The existing motion-to-pure-act candidate preserves this SCG I.16 existential conclusion. The case requires this very first mover to be pure act in every relevant respect. The identity of the witnesses needs a bridge.
